Same page and same content as source 2: 81 team rows for problems A to M.
Page headed 'ICPC 2023 Internet Programming Contest' with 673 rows and problems A to J, from the same site and year.
Table of 80 ranked teams with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation columns and no per-problem cells.
Codeforces gym 105627 dashboard titled The 2023 ICPC Asia Tehran Regional Contest listing problems A to M.
PDF of 16 pages headed '2023 ICPC Asia Tehran Regional Contest' with judging notes and problems A to M.
PDF of 10 pages whose first lines name the 20th Iran Internet Programming Contest, Tehran Site, Qualification Round, 1 May 2024, with problems A to J.

tehran-2024.notes: Sources 4 and 9 are the 2024 Online Regional Contest (20 November 2024, 755 teams, 10 problems), found inside the site; it is a separate contest from the on-site one and has no catalogue entry (a tehran-online-2024 would be its home). Scoreboard (source 2) has 81 rows, the CMS standings (source 5) 79; the two extra rows solved nothing.

sources.evidence: The seed page announces the 25th Asian Regional Contest in Iran, 19-20 December 2024, hosted by Sharif University of Technology, and the site has registration, info, people, archive and photo pages.
Page titled 'ICPC 2024 - Scoreboard' with 81 team rows of per-problem time, attempts and result for A-K embedded in its script, and a totals row.
Same size and checksum as the copy of the other scoreboard address, same title 'ICPC 2024 - Scoreboard'.

The page is titled 'IIPC 2024 - Scoreboard', time stamp Wed Nov 20 22:15:17 IRST 2024, 755 teams and problems A-J: the Online Regional Contest of 20 November 2024, not the on-site contest of 19-20 December.
Table of 79 team rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal, Citation, Site citation under the heading 'The 2024 ICPC Asia Tehran Regional Contest'.
PDF of 18 pages with judging notes on page 1 and Problems A to K (Yalda ... Boat), matching the problems of the 2024 regional contest.
PDF of 11 pages headed '2024 ICPC Asia Tehran – Online Regional Contest' with ten problems A-J (Tired Shepherd ... Greedy Table), not the on-site set of A-K.

tehran-2025.notes: Sources 4 and 7 are the 2025 Online Regional Contest (12 November 2025, 892 teams, 10 problems), found inside the site; it is a separate contest from the on-site one and has no catalogue entry.
